main_text.p: 15.16.19.22.31.64. Vt vero hęc ipsa apertius, Materiæ com[?] felicius, facilius ad vsum transferantur i-folat[?]num variæ. mitandoque exprimantur, res ipsas atque materias obseruare oportet, quæ in Ciceronis epistolis familiaribus reperiuntur. Sunt enim in illis commendationes variæ. Amicorum generales, vt humane illi excipiantur & tractentur. lib.13. epist.3.6.14.20. 25.31.32.34.35.39.46.48.52.60.71.74. page.notes: Marginal note at top right is damaged: "Materiæ com" is partly readable and the second line "folat:num" is run together with the third line "variæ." Readings marked [?] are doubtful. The small raised marks beside "folat" are not clear. Several lines of the text are faint or have ink fill-in at the edges (e.g. "lib.7." and "epist.5."), but all words are legible. Printed spelling "ipfa", "exiftimationis", "defenfione" and "epift." uses long s, normalised to plain s per the rules. The line ending "Mer-" is a running word that continues on the next page, so no catchword is given.
